Native glazing stays upright/forward-facing, even if the hammerhead BODY is rotated.

No skulls, pirate rust patchwork, demonic spikes, cathedral ornament, modern stealth fighter canopy or passenger windows.

These are five views of the SAME design, same engine count, wings, fins and cockpit. Overhead means looking down: vertical fins are edge-on. Glazing must stay detailed enough to recognize. Two broad upper hatch panels on the thick centre. Style: calm sculpted faceted surfaces with inset mechanical bands and dark undersides, sea-green shoulder fields. Not a flying saucer: distinct angular front, rear and diagonals.
